## About
Voltek is an independent Volvo shop in Denver, run by Joe Halbert and Chris Hernon. Both are Denver natives who came up through local Volvo shops and Rickenbaugh Volvo. Joe started out as a chef before switching gears to cars. Chris began as a helicopter mechanic and crew chief for the U.S. Army National Guard and has earned Volvo Master Tech and ASE master tech ratings.
We've been working on Volvo cars in the Denver and Boulder area for decades, and driving them almost as long. We beat dealership prices and we don't try to sell you a bunch of stuff you don't need.
Our customers have rated us 4.9 from 241 Google reviews. One customer wrote that it's worth the trip from Dillon, Colorado.

## Services
- Factory scheduled service: The maintenance your Volvo calls for, done by people who know every model.
- Wheel alignment: Listed as a special on our site. Visit our specials page for details. ($110)
- Oil change: Routine oil changes and tune-ups, or more extensive repairs when you need them.
- Key programming: Our diagnostic equipment lets us program keys and remotes and update module software. Call for pricing and details.
- Brake system repair: Brake work for Volvo cars new and old.
- Timing belt service: Timing belt work done right for your model.
- Electrical system diagnosis and repair: We use a specialized diagnostic system to find the problem before we fix it.
- Used car evaluations: Thinking about buying a used Volvo? Have us look it over first.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer loaner cars?
A: Yes. We offer free loaner cars during repair only, so it's easy to drop your car off on your way to work.

Q: Do you work on newer Volvo models?
A: Yes. We service all Volvo models, new and old.

Q: How do I make an appointment?
A: Give us a call, or send the contact form if you have a question.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're on the east corner where Emerson comes to an end.

Q: Are you part of Volvo?
A: No. Voltek is an independent repair shop and is not affiliated with Volvo Cars.
